notes.content: Foreign Language Requirement- for B.A. in Liberal Arts and Sciences
Competency (successfully completing the third college semester or fifth college quarter) is required in one foreign language to fulfill graduation requirements for this major.

notes.content: The Applied Arts and Sciences degree is open only to students who have completed the California Community College Associate in Arts in Psychology for Transfer (AA-T) degree completing the Transfer Model Curriculum (TMC) for Psychology.
